why: phase-515 R10 (maintainer decision 2026-10-27: the node is the parameter receiver, as rclrs's is). `Node::set_parameters_atomically` forwards to `Executor::set_parameters_atomically_on(node_id, ...)` with this node's id; the store is still the executor's one table (phase-426 W1), and the executor's bare primary-node form is deprecated. rclrs's `Node` has no `set_parameters_atomically` -- the counterpart is rclcpp's `Node::set_parameters_atomically` -- so this extends the rclrs surface with a verb the ROS 2 parameter model has. Test: `packages/core/nros-node/src/executor/tests.rs` (`the_node_is_the_parameter_receiver`).
